params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry the script runs over. With nothing connected the script runs on empty geometry and can build its own.

params.name: Class
params.description: What the script runs once for: each point, each primitive, or once for the whole geometry (Detail). Sets what @P and @name refer to.

params.name: Group
params.description: A group of the chosen class limiting which elements the script runs on. Empty means all; ignored in Detail class.

params.name: Code
params.description: The Rhai script run per element. @name reads or writes an attribute, ch("path") reads a parameter. Applies on ctrl+enter or when leaving the editor; an error leaves the input unchanged.
